name: Plaza Volente
summary: Plaza Volente is a neighborhood shopping center on Guadalupe Street in central Austin, managed by Kite Realty Group. With a 4.7-star rating, it serves the West Campus area and nearby UT Austin community with convenient retail and services.
demographics: Plaza Volente serves the central Austin market along Guadalupe Street, attracting a diverse mix of university students from nearby UT Austin, young urban professionals, and established residents of the West Campus and Hyde Park neighborhoods. The trade area features higher education levels and tech-industry employment, with visitors typically in the 22-45 age range seeking convenient neighborhood retail and services. The center draws both pedestrian traffic from the dense surrounding residential areas and commuters along the Guadalupe corridor, with shopping patterns favoring quick-trip convenience purchases and local service needs.
description: Plaza Volente is a neighborhood shopping center strategically located at 422 Guadalupe Street in the heart of Austin, Texas. Managed by Kite Realty Group, a prominent real estate investment trust specializing in retail properties across the United States, this center serves as a convenient retail destination for the vibrant West Campus area. The property benefits from its prime location along Guadalupe Street, one of Austin's key commercial corridors, providing easy access for both local residents and the nearby University of Texas community. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Plaza Volente offers a welcoming environment for shoppers seeking everyday conveniences and services. The center has earned strong community recognition with a 4.7-star rating from 88 reviews, reflecting its role as a valued neighborhood retail hub in one of Austin's most dynamic and growing urban districts.
